observation.visible_scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a dark glossy surface marked with diagonal golden/bronze stripes. Near the center-right sits a single translucent, faceted object (ice-cube/gem-like) with a frosted white patch on its top face and clear facets below. A blue plastic object with vertical ridges/slits occupies the upper-left corner, and a bright square-ish reflection of a light source (with a hot white dot) appears in the lower-left. The lighting and reflections are constant.
visible_changes: The central translucent object stays in essentially the same position relative to the striped surface across all frames; no translation, rotation, or deformation of it is clearly visible.

The diagonal stripe pattern and the lower-left light reflection shift slightly in orientation and position from the first to the last frame, an apparent global change consistent with small handheld camera drift/tilt rather than motion of the objects themselves.
The blue ridged object at the upper-left remains fixed at the frame edge, with only a minor apparent angle change matching the camera drift.
No contact, sliding, tipping, or completion of any action involving the central object occurs within the excerpt; the interval is largely static apart from the subtle camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the central object is ice and whether it is melting or has just been placed; the cause and direction of the slight camera drift; any motion or events before the first frame or after the last frame.
uncertain_details: The exact material of the central object (ice cube vs. clear resin/gemstone) cannot be confirmed.
Very subtle changes in the object's edge definition and transparency may hint at slow melting, but they are not distinguishable from lighting/reflection variation and are not asserted.
The lower-left bright shape is a reflection on the glossy surface, not a separate physical object.
